lines.text: Because we fear the Lord, we try to persuade men, and we give you an occasion to be proud of us.
Christ's love compels us, because One died for all, so that those who live should live for Him.
We regard no one according to the flesh, and if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation.
God reconciled us to Himself through Christ, and we are priests of the temple, imploring you to be reconciled to God.
God made Him who knew no sin to be sin for us, and Paul says now is the day of Moses.
